answer: Make trust a shale quarry no farm can strip bare: a newcomer stakes a small claim, then drills a kernel core through layers of useful work in unrelated domains, each layer checked by a different stranger, so no single clique can certify a fake. The core binds to one key and its thread of signed samples cannot be copied, because every layer carries a fresh verifier mark. Standing thaws slowly, like rock giving up its core, and idle claims erode. Sybil farms must stake a claim, drill a fresh core, and pass new strangers for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
